title: South Carolina Army National Guard response to Hurricane Florence
description: Members of South Carolina Army National Guard's 1053rd Transportation Company reposition unit vehicles after refueling and picking up life jackets in Manning, S.C., in preparation for possible high-water rescue missions in response to Hurricane Florence, Sept. 14, 2018. (U.S. Army National Guard video by South Carolina National Guard)
